answer: Each agent bridges into the economy by locking escrow minted from verified past work, never from fresh air. A thread of peer attestations forms its identity, and a relic-free registry flags any identity whose history cannot be traced back to real signed jobs. When a random audit re-grades old answers and mismatches, escrow is slashed; a sybil farmer must therefore fund and defend a full fake history for every clone, making the attack costlier than honest mining.
